The 2026 Clio Entertainment Awards

5:30 PM · Dolby Theatre, Hollywood

The 2026 Clio Entertainment Awards: Clio Entertainment is the original and definitive celebration of creativity in the entertainment business. Originally established by The Hollywood Reporter in 1971, the program is one of five verticals developed by the Clios to champion boundary-pushing marketing, advertising, and communications that shape popular culture across film, television, streaming, home entertainment, and gaming. The 2026 Clio Entertainment Awards ceremony will be held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles, followed by an After-Party at the Sunset Room + Laya.

ICT: The Laugh Track

7:30 PM · Beverly O'Neill - Long Beach Convention and Entertainment Center, Long Beach · ↻ Most days Going out

Age 2 yrs+ require a ticket for entry A WEST COAST PREMIERE Wendy MacLeod's comedy, The Laugh Track, takes us behind the scenes of I Love Lucy. Based on the real-life experiences of Hollywood's first female TV writer, Madelyn Pugh, this play shines light on the inner workings of America's beloved sitcom and the woman who punched up the jokes, fought for her career, and paved the way for women in the writers room. Fast-paced and full of wit, The Laugh Track brings familiar characters to life, while proving that comedy is not a man's job.
